alive.last_commit_message:
feat(prompt-security): add RefusalLadderJailbreaking multi-turn attack (#780)

When the target model refuses, this new multi-turn operator automatically
climbs an ordered remediation ladder (retry -> prefill -> authorized-framing
-> simulator rewrite), re-rolling on a clean session each time, and stops at
the first non-refusal.

- Reuses the existing Crescendo refusal/eval judges and generate_schema utils
- Follows the BaseAttack contract (sync + async), mirroring existing operators
- Registered in multi_turn/__init__.py and cli/mappings.py (TECHNIQUE_CLASS_MAP)
  so it resolves for --techniques and --scan-tools
- Adds tests/test_refusal_ladder.py and updates the README technique tables (EN/ZH)

Co-authored-by: lixufeng <lixufeng@example.com>
